info.name: Get A List Of Dynamic Parsing Rules.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of dynamic parsing rules returned in the response. The number of dynamic parsing rules returned may be less than the `limit`.

params.name: token
params.description: Continuation token to get the next page of results. A page object with the next continuation token is returned in the response body. Subsequent GET requests should specify the continuation token to get the next page of results.

items.docs: Get a list of all dynamic parsing rules. The response is paginated with a default limit of 100 dynamic parsing rules per page.

info.name: Create A New Dynamic Parsing Rule.

items.docs: Create a new dynamic parsing rule.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of dynamic parsing rule to return.

items.docs: Get a dynamic parsing rule with the given identifier.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the dynamic parsing rule to update.

items.docs: Update an existing dynamic parsing rule. All properties specified in the request are replaced. Missing properties are set to their default values.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the dynamic parsing rule to delete.

items.docs: Delete a dynamic parsing rule with the given identifier.
